interactionNotes: Select presentation is always the trigger label. The menu shows presentation names, the active checkmark, and + New presentation. Hovering a named entry carries the canvas mini-map preview forward.

Each thumbnail is draggable in either layout. Shift selects a contiguous range. Ctrl toggles individual slides. A drop between thumbnails inserts the selected slides there as a group, preserving their relative order.

Sort on canvas arranges the active presentation’s frames in slideshow order. Canvas positions are shared by all presentations that reference those frames. Each presentation retains its own slideshow order.
Small decks show every thumbnail on the toolbar datum when they fit. Larger decks use the full grid with subtle horizontal row dividers.
